say:4:1028206001:0.text: All the fruit is gone! Misarte accepted my offering!
say:4:1028206001:0.source_cn: ……咦？贡果不见了！弥萨忒收下我的祭品了！

say:5:1028206002:0.text: Oh, Misarte, goddess of the earth and rivers! Please make my wish come true.
say:5:1028206002:0.source_cn: 弥萨忒，大地与河川之神，赞美您！请您倾听我的请求，实现...

say:6:1028206003:0.text: My name is Randy. I'm a student at the Jade Lake Academy... You probably know that already.
say:6:1028206003:0.source_cn: 我叫兰迪，是翡湖学院的学生……这您应该已经知道了。

say:7:1028206004:0.text: I-I'm not doing so well in school. Compared to other students, I'm not as clever, and I don't have any special skills.
say:7:1028206004:0.source_cn: 我……我在学校过得不好。和同学比起来，我不太机灵，也没...

say:8:1028206005:0.text: Misarte, please grant me a gift of talent. I wish to speak with the wind or be stronger or faster. No matter what happens, I'll use my talents for the good of the Wilders!
say:8:1028206005:0.source_cn: 弥萨忒，请您赐给我天赋吧，风语的能力也好，灵巧的身体也...

say:12:1028206006:0.text: Misarte... they were his fruit... We really ate his offerings!
say:12:1028206006:0.source_cn: 弥萨忒，贡果……天啊，我们真的吃了贡品！！

say:13:1028206007:0.text: And he thinks Misarte accepted the offering and will grant him his wish...
say:13:1028206007:0.source_cn: 而且他觉得弥萨忒收下了贡品，会为他实现愿望……

say:17:1028206008:0.source_cn: 嗯？周围似乎有什么动静……

say:18:1028206009:0.text: ...Misarte! Did you grant my wish already?! Do I have extra senses now?! Praise the Wildmother!
say:18:1028206009:0.source_cn: 难道说……弥萨忒，您实现了我的愿望，让我的感官变得更加...

say:19:1028206010:0.text: What gifts have you given me? The ability to speak with the wind, or perhaps some great physical strength?
say:19:1028206010:0.source_cn: 您赐予了我什么天赋？能倾听风的声音，或是强大的力量？

choice_prompt:20:1028206010.text: What gifts have you given me? The ability to speak with the wind, or perhaps some great physical strength?
choice_prompt:20:1028206010.source_cn: 您赐予了我什么天赋？能倾听风的声音，或是强大的力量？

say:21:1028206011:0.text: ... Are you testing me by staying silent? Do you want me to find out for myself?
say:21:1028206011:0.source_cn: ……您不说话，是考验我，要我自己去寻找吗？

say:22:1028206012:0.text: I understand. Maybe I'll explore tomorrow and see what I can do... Actually, why don't I go test things out right now?
say:22:1028206012:0.source_cn: 我明白了，我明天……不，我现在就去发掘自己的天赋！

say:30:1028206014:0.text: He's just a child. It's dangerous for him to go into the forest alone!
say:30:1028206014:0.source_cn: 呀，他一个小孩子，独自去森林里很危险的！

say:31:1028206015:0.text: We have to find a way to get him back to the academy!
say:31:1028206015:0.source_cn: 咱们得想办法让他回学院去！

narration:33:10282212:0.text: Randy eagerly dashes into the forest, excited to discover his talent.
narration:33:10282212:0.source_cn: 兰迪兴奋地跑进森林，准备挖掘自己的天赋。

narration:34:10282211:0.text: Before long, a young boy arrives at the Temple.
narration:34:10282211:0.source_cn: 没过多久，一个小男孩来到了供奉处。
